series.name: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)
series.notes: Commercial three-phase string. LCD prints TEXT names only. Table 9.1 of this manual carries two AFCI-only rows (AFCI self-detection, Arcing protection) that the S5-GR3P 3-13k table does NOT have, so this block is kept separate from SERIES 2. Only THREE LEDs on this model (POWER / OPERATION / ALARM) - no battery LED, no Bluetooth LED. This block is also the home of the on-grid-scope parallel and 3-phase communication codes (1060-106C) because the official Solis alarm library files them under 'Only Grid Connection'; the hybrid blocks keep their own 1060-106C rows with DIFFERENT names - see CONFLICTS.

meaning.en: The built-in arc-fault detection module failed its own power-on self test, so the inverter will not run with AFCI enabled.
meaning.ur: Built-in arc-fault detection module apna power-on self test fail kar chuka hai, is liye AFCI on par inverter chalega nahi.

causes.en: AFCI module board not seated or its ribbon cable unplugged
causes.ur: AFCI module board fit nahi hai ya uska ribbon cable nikal hua hai

causes.en: AFCI firmware version mismatch after a partial update
causes.ur: Adhoora update ke baad AFCI firmware version mismatch ho gaya

solutions.en: Switch AC and DC off, wait for the LEDs and LCD to go dark, then power up once and note whether the message returns.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC off karein, LEDs aur LCD band hone tak wait karein, phir ek baar power karke dekhein ke message wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: With power removed, reseat the AFCI board and its ribbon connector, then re-run the AFCI ON/OFF check in Advanced Settings > 0010 > Special Settings > AFCI Set.
solutions.ur: Power nikal kar AFCI board aur uska ribbon connector dobara fit karein, phir Advanced Settings > 0010 > Special Settings > AFCI Set mein AFCI ON/OFF check dobara karein.

solutions.en: If the AFCI module still fails its self test after a clean power cycle, the module itself is defective - request an RMA replacement.
solutions.ur: Clean power cycle ke baad bhi AFCI module apna self test fail kare to module hi kharab hai - RMA replacement maangein.

notes.en: The S5-GC manual prints this row as text only. The official Solis alarm library files the AFCI self-test as '1040 AFCI-Check / AFCI self-test failure' on hybrid platforms, so 1040 is listed as an alias but is not printed on the S5-GC LCD.
notes.ur: S5-GC manual mein ye row sirf text ke tor par hai. Official Solis alarm library hybrid platform par AFCI self-test ko '1040 AFCI-Check' ke tor par rakhta hai, is liye 1040 alias mein hai lekin S5-GC LCD par nahi chhota.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

title.ur: DC arc fault detect hua (Arcing protection)

meaning.en: The AFCI module sensed an arc in the DC circuit and locked the inverter out until the arc is removed.
meaning.ur: AFCI module ne DC circuit mein arc detect kiya aur arc hatne tak inverter ko lock kar diya.

causes.en: Loose or badly crimped MC4 connector, or DC cable pinched under the array
causes.ur: Loose ya khulon se crimped MC4 connector, ya array ke neeche pinch hua DC cable

causes.en: Damaged module backsheet, cracked panel glass or a connector with stripped-back insulation
causes.ur: Kharab module backsheet, cracked panel ka glass, ya insulation nikal chuki connector

solutions.en: Turn AC and DC off, then walk the whole string in daylight and look for a blackened, melted or loose MC4 pair.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC off karein, phir din mein poori string check karein aur kala, pighla hua ya loose MC4 pair dhoondein.

solutions.en: Discharge the DC side, then crimp every connector again with a proper crimp tool and confirm polarity is correct.
solutions.ur: DC side discharge karein, phir har connector ko proper crimp tool se dobara crimp karein aur polarity sahi hai confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure PV+ and PV- to earth with a multimeter; a reading that does not fall between 5 % and 95 % of one module Voc points to a damaged string.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se PV+ aur PV- ko earth ke against measure karein; jo reading ek module ke Voc ke 5 % se 95 % ke darmiyan na giray to kharab string ka pata chal jata hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow alarm LED flashing + arc message on LCD

notes.en: On the S5-GC the LCD shows the text 'Arcing protection'; the hex form 1041 ARC-FAULT is what the official Solis library and SolisCloud use for the same event.
notes.ur: S5-GC par LCD text 'Arcing protection' dikhata hai; hex form 1041 ARC-FAULT wohi event official Solis library aur SolisCloud mein use hota hai.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

meaning.en: The inverter sees too much impedance between itself and the grid, usually a long or thin AC interconnect cable on a 25-60 kW unit.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur grid ke darmiyan impedance zyada hai, aksar 25-60 kW unit par lamba ya patla AC interconnect cable.

causes.en: AC interconnect cable undersized or longer than the inverter spec allows
causes.ur: AC interconnect cable chhota ya manual se zyada lamba hai

causes.en: Loose AC lugs at the inverter or the main panel adding contact resistance
causes.ur: Inverter ya main panel par AC lugs loose hain jis se contact resistance barh gaya

solutions.en: Measure L1-L2, L2-L3 and L3-L1 at the inverter and again at the main panel while the plant is at full output, and write down the difference.
solutions.ur: Plant poora output par hone ke waqt inverter par L1-L2, L2-L3 aur L3-L1 measure karein aur phir main panel par bhi, farq note karein.

solutions.en: If the drop across the run is high, fit a larger cross-section AC cable as the Solis cable specification requires.
solutions.ur: Agar run par drop zyada hai to Solis cable specification ke mutabiq bari cross-section AC cable lagayein.

solutions.en: Only widen the protection window through User-Define if the DISCO / utility allows it in writing.
solutions.ur: DISCO ya utility likhit ijazat de tabhi User-Define se protection window barhayein.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

meaning.en: The screen is completely dead. On a three-phase S5-GC the DC input must be above 350 V for the unit to even start.
meaning.ur: Screen bilkul dead hai. Three-phase S5-GC par DC input start karne ke liye 350 V se upar hona chahiye.

causes.en: DC switch open, DCDB tripped, or the PV string disconnected
causes.ur: DC switch khula, DCDB trip, ya PV string disconnect

causes.en: PV+/- reversed so the unit never starts
causes.ur: PV+/- reverse hai is liye unit start hi nahi hota

solutions.en: Check the DC switch and the DCDB first, then measure each string Voc at the inverter DC terminals with the DC switch OFF.
solutions.ur: Pehle DC switch aur DCDB check karein, phir DC switch OFF karke har string ka Voc inverter DC terminal par measure karein.

solutions.en: Confirm polarity: on a three-phase unit every string must read above 350 V open-circuit.
solutions.ur: Polarity confirm karein: three-phase unit par har string ka open-circuit reading 350 V se upar honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Close the AC breaker and DCDB, then power up in the manual order (AC first, DC after 60 s) and watch all three LEDs.
solutions.ur: AC breaker aur DCDB band karein, phir manual ke order par power karein (pehle AC, 60 second baad DC) aur teenon LEDs dekhein.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.code: LCD show initializing all the time
aliases: LCD show initializing all the time

title.ur: Initializing par atka hua, start nahi ho raha

meaning.en: The unit powers up but never leaves the initializing state, so the main screen stays blank.
meaning.ur: Unit power le leta hai lekin initializing state se bahar nahi nikalta, is liye main screen khaali rehta hai.

causes.en: Connector on the main board or the power board has come loose
causes.ur: Main board ya power board ka connector loose ho gaya

causes.en: DSP-to-power-board connector unseated after transport or a firmware update
causes.ur: Transport ya firmware update ke baad DSP-to-power-board connector fit nahi raha

solutions.en: Switch AC and DC off and wait a full 5 minutes for the bus to discharge before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi chhoone se pehle AC aur DC off karein aur bus discharge hone ke liye poore 5 minute wait karein.

solutions.en: With the power off, reseat every connector on the main board and power board, especially the DSP-to-power-board connector.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke main board aur power board ke har connector, khaas kar DSP-to-power-board connector, dobara fit karein.

solutions.en: Power up and check the OPERATION LED: solid ON means running, FLASHING means still initializing.
solutions.ur: Power karke OPERATION LED dekhein: solid ON ka matlab chal raha hai, FLASHING ka matlab abhi initialize ho raha hai.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

meaning.en: The inverter detected a high ambient or heatsink temperature on a 25-60 kW cabinet and stopped.
meaning.ur: 25-60 kW cabinet par inverter ne ambient ya heatsink temperature zyada detect ki aur ruk gaya.

causes.en: Direct afternoon sun on the inverter cabinet
causes.ur: Dopahar ki dhoop seedhi inverter cabinet par gir rahi hai

causes.en: Blocked heatsink airflow from dust, mud or a soffit above
causes.ur: Heatsink ka airflow dhool, gadda ya upar ke chhat se band ho gaya

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature next to the cabinet with a thermometer and compare it with the internal temperature in Advanced Information > Running Status.
solutions.ur: Cabinet ke paas thermometer se ambient temperature measure karein aur Advanced Information > Running Status ke internal temperature se compare karein.

solutions.en: Clear dust from the heatsink and restore the clearance given in the installation section; keep direct sun off the cabinet.
solutions.ur: Heatsink ki dhool saaf karein aur installation section di hui clearance wapas rakhein; cabinet par seedhi dhoop na aane dein.

solutions.en: If ambient is under 60 °C and it still trips, the internal NTC sensor or the external fan is at fault - RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar ambient 60 °C se kam hai phir bhi trip kare to internal NTC sensor ya external fan kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

meaning.en: In a multi-inverter 3-phase plant the master stopped answering on the parallel communication bus, so the group shut down.
meaning.ur: Multi-inverter 3-phase plant mein master ne parallel communication bus par jawab dena band kar diya, is liye poora group band ho gaya.

causes.en: Parallel communication cable loose, missing cores or unshielded
causes.ur: Parallel communication cable loose, kuch cores missing, ya unshielded

causes.en: DIP / address switches of two inverters set to the same value
causes.ur: Do inverters ke DIP ya address switches same value par set hain

solutions.en: Power down the whole group, then reseat the 8-core shielded parallel cable at both ends and confirm every core is continuous.
solutions.ur: Poore group ko power down karein, phir 8-core shielded parallel cable dono taraf se dobara fit karein aur har core ki continuity check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the DIP switch positions of every inverter, and make sure only one unit is set as master.
solutions.ur: Har inverter ke DIP switch ki position verify karein, aur confirm karein ke sirf ek unit master hai.

solutions.en: Power the group back up and confirm the alarm clears; if it returns immediately, replace the parallel cable with a known-good one.
solutions.ur: Group dobara power karein aur alarm hatne ki confirm karein; foran wapas aaye to parallel cable ko chalte hue cable se replace karein.

notes.en: In the official Solis library 1065 is filed twice: 'Only Grid Connection' = HeartbeatLose and 'Only Energy Storage' = HeartbeatLose. Same name, different status codes, so the numeric code alone is not safe to reuse across platforms.
notes.ur: Official Solis library mein 1065 do jagah hai: 'Only Grid Connection' = HeartbeatLose aur 'Only Energy Storage' = HeartbeatLose. Naam same hai lekin status code alag, is liye sirf number ko platform ke darmiyan reuse karna safe nahi.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

title.ur: Do inverters ka address aapas mein same (1064 Addr-Conflict)

meaning.en: Two or more inverters in the parallel group are configured with the same address, so the master sees duplicate replies.
meaning.ur: Parallel group mein do ya zyada inverters ka address same hai, is liye master ko duplicate reply dikhti hai.

causes.en: Inverter cloned with the same address during a firmware reflash or a unit swap
causes.ur: Firmware reflash ya unit exchange ke waqt clone kiye gaye inverter ka address same reh gaya

causes.en: Address not reset after a master unit was replaced on site
causes.ur: Master unit badalne ke baad address reset nahi kiya gaya

solutions.en: Go to Settings on each inverter and read out the slave address one unit at a time, writing the value down.
solutions.ur: Har inverter par Settings mein jayein aur slave address ek-ek karke padhein, value note kar lein.

solutions.en: Give every unit a unique address, keeping address 1 for the master only, then power cycle the group.
solutions.ur: Har unit ko unique address dein, sirf master ka 1 rakhein, phir group ko power cycle karein.

solutions.en: Re-check the addresses after the restart; two units still reporting the same number means the address did not save.
solutions.ur: Restart ke baad address dobara check karein; do unit ka number aaj bhi same ho to address save nahi hua.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

meaning.en: The internal CAN bus between the inverters in the group has dropped, so the group cannot run as one unit.
meaning.ur: Group ke inverters ke darmiyan internal CAN bus gir gaya, is liye group ek unit ke tor par nahi chal sakta.

causes.en: CAN / parallel signal connector not fully seated
causes.ur: CAN ya parallel signal connector puri tarah fit nahi hua

causes.en: Shield or earth of the communication cable broken, letting noise into the bus
causes.ur: Communication cable ka shield ya earth toota, is liye bus mein noise aa raha hai

solutions.en: Switch everything off, then push each CAN connector home with a firm click and check the earth of the communication cable.
solutions.ur: Sab kuch off karein, phir har CAN connector ko zor se click ke saath baithayein aur communication cable ki earth check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the resistance of the CAN_H and CAN_L wires end to end; both wires must read the same low resistance with no break.
solutions.ur: CAN_H aur CAN_L wire ki aakhir se aakhir resistance measure karein; dono wires ki low resistance same honi chahiye, koi break nahi.

solutions.en: If the wiring measures good, power up one unit at a time to find which unit is holding the bus down, then RMA that unit.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek nikle to ek-ek karke unit power karein aur dekhein kaun sa unit bus ko rok raha hai, phir us unit ka RMA karein.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

meaning.en: The three-phase networking configuration is wrong: a phase is missing or one inverter is assigned to two phases.
meaning.ur: Three-phase networking configuration ghalat hai: koi phase missing hai ya ek inverter do phases par set hai.

causes.en: One phase of the three-phase networking system has no inverter assigned
causes.ur: Three-phase networking system ki ek phase par koi inverter assign nahi hai

causes.en: Phase assignment on an inverter changed without re-running the network setup
causes.ur: Phase assignment badal diya gaya lekin network setup dobara nahi chalaya gaya

solutions.en: Open Advanced Settings > 0010 on each inverter and write down which phases it is assigned to.
solutions.ur: Har inverter par Advanced Settings > 0010 kholein aur note karein ke usse kaun si phases di gayi hain.

solutions.en: Confirm with a phase rotation meter at the main panel that the grid is L1-L2-L3, then correct the per-inverter phase setting.
solutions.ur: Main panel par phase rotation meter se confirm karein ke grid L1-L2-L3 hai, phir per-inverter phase setting theek karein.

solutions.en: Look for a fault on any member inverter of the group, fix it, then fully power off the group and bring it back up.
solutions.ur: Group ke kisi member inverter ka fault dhoondein, theek karein, phir group ko poori tarah power off karke dobara chalayein.

notes.en: The official Solis library gives 106C the name 3P_CreateFail on the grid-connection scope and 3P_CreateFaACil on the energy-storage scope, so the same number has two spellings across platforms.
notes.ur: Official Solis library mein 106C ka naam grid-connection scope par 3P_CreateFail hai aur energy-storage scope par 3P_CreateFaACil, is liye ek hi number ke do roop hain.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

meaning.en: Solid ON means the inverter is supplying power; FLASHING means it is still initialising; OFF means it has stopped supplying.
meaning.ur: Solid ON ka matlab inverter power de raha hai; FLASHING ka matlab abhi initialize ho raha hai; OFF ka matlab power dena band kar chuka hai.

causes.en: Normal running state
causes.ur: Normal chalne ki halat

causes.en: Self-check / initialisation state after a power cycle
causes.ur: Power cycle ke baad self-check ya initialisation ki halat

solutions.en: No action needed when solid ON; read the LCD home screen for live power figures.
solutions.ur: Solid ON par koi action nahi; live power ke liye LCD home screen padhein.

solutions.en: If the LED has been FLASHING for more than 5 minutes, follow the initializing-fault procedure.
solutions.ur: Agar LED 5 minute se zyada FLASHING kar raha ho to initializing-fault wali procedure follow karein.

codes.blinkPattern: OPERATION LED solid ON = running, FLASHING = initialising, OFF = stopped

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

meaning.en: ON means a fault or alarm condition has been detected. On the S5-GC the earth-fault case flashes the yellow alarm indicator and shows PVISO-PRO on the LCD.
meaning.ur: ON ka matlab fault ya alarm detect hua hai. S5-GC par earth-fault ki surat mein yellow alarm indicator flash karta hai aur LCD par PVISO-PRO aata hai.

causes.en: Any entry in the alarm log - the LED only signals, it does not identify the code
causes.ur: Alarm log mein koi bhi entry - LED sirf ishara karta hai, code nahi batata

causes.en: PV earth fault: the manual states the yellow alarm indicator flashes and PVISO-PRO shows on the LCD
causes.ur: PV earth fault: manual ke mutabiq yellow alarm indicator flash karta hai aur LCD par PVISO-PRO aata hai

solutions.en: Open Enter > Down > Advanced Information > password 0010 > Alarm Message to read the last 100 alarms with date and time.
solutions.ur: Enter > Down > Advanced Information > password 0010 > Alarm Message kholein aur date-time ke saath pichle 100 alarms padhein.

solutions.en: If the yellow alarm LED is flashing, treat it as a PV earth fault: isolate AC and PV before any insulation measurement.
solutions.ur: Agar yellow alarm LED flash kar raha ho to use PV earth fault samajhein: insulation measure karne se pehle AC aur PV isolate karein.

solutions.en: Write down the alarm text, the Information-menu readings and the inverter serial number before calling service.
solutions.ur: Service call karne se pehle alarm text, Information-menu readings aur inverter serial number likh lein.

codes.blinkPattern: ALARM LED solid ON = fault, flashing yellow = PV earth fault (PVISO-PRO)
